title: SPECT Strada and Mira: what is known about the new brand
notes: Independent launch assessment reports a quoted 900-940 g Mira frame, T1100 + M90 lay-up and unresolved geometry/delivery changes. It reports 35 mm rear and 38 mm front fit, conflicting with the retailer's 32C claim. It also reports that SPECT called its development frame too stiff and was re-tuning the lay-up; no numeric or delivered-frame test exists.
